reason: Split from A1 by the reviewer: new step covering the scope summary tiles and Backlog drill-down.

changes.after: Under `Release 0.3.0 scope: this release vs backlog`, expect three tiles: `This release: planned work` showing P + C features and `N of P + C passed`; `Added after the cut` showing A with `C counted in this release · A − C in backlog`; `Backlog: not this release` showing B + (A − C). Each tile also shows its open-bug count. Click the Backlog tile: the page shows `Backlog: not this release: B + (A − C)`, its feature rows include qr-gated-outputs and global-change-standard, and the trail reads `Overview › Backlog: not this release`.
changes.whyNeeded: Covers the new summary and its drill-down.
